create_cohere_asr_processor: create a CohereAsrProcessor with a feature_extractor and tokenizer for automatic speech recognition
build_decoder_prompt_ids: build decoder prompt token IDs for a given language and punctuation settings
process_audio_input: process audio input with language, punctuation, and optional text labels for ASR training
decode_transcription_chunks: decode ASR output token IDs into text strings with optional chunk reassembly
reassemble_chunk_texts: reassemble per-chunk transcription texts back into per-sample strings using audio chunk index mapping
